translationRepairs: In autumn, the seventh month, on xinhai, Lu Wenji, director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Jointly with the Secretariat Under the Gate Pallarak Grand Councillor.

In autumn, the seventh month, on xinhai, Lu Wenji, director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and joint manager of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.

Focus unit has 同中書門下平章事; “Pallarak Grand Councillor” is a corrupt non-word rendering of that office. The proposed “joint manager of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery” restores the standard sense while keeping the rest of the literal appointment wording.
In the eighth month, on xinwei, Yao Ting, Left Vice Director of the Ministries, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Jointly with the Secretariat Under the Gate Pallarak Grand Councillor.
In the eighth month, on xinwei, Yao Ting, Left Vice Director of the Ministries, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and joint manager of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.
Same corrupt “Pallarak” rendering of 同中書門下平章事 in the Yao Ting appointment; the proposed office phrase matches the Chinese and leaves the surrounding literal intact.

In the twelfth month, on jihai, Zhang Yanlang, military governor of the Xiongwu army, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Jointly with the Secretariat Under the Gate Pallarak Grand Councillor.
In the twelfth month, on jihai, Zhang Yanlang, military governor of the Xiongwu army, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and joint manager of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.

Zhang Yanlang’s appointment likewise ends in 同中書門下平章事; replacing the garbled “Pallarak Grand Councillor” with “joint manager of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery” corrects the office without changing agents or dates.

In the third month, on bingwu, Ma Yinsun, Hanlin academician and Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Jointly with the Secretariat Under the Gate Pallarak Grand Councillor.

In the third month, on bingwu, Ma Yinsun, Hanlin academician and Vice Director of the Ministry of Rites, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and joint manager of affairs with the Secretariat-Chancellery.
Ma Yinsun’s line has the same 同中書門下平章事 title; the before text’s “Pallarak” is not a real reading, and the proposed literal restores the standard Secretariat-Chancellery office translation.
Li Congke, Prince of Lu and military governor of Fengxiang, rose in rebellion.
Congke, Prince of Lu and military governor of Fengxiang, rebelled.

Focus unit names 潞王從珂 with no surname 李; idiomatic “Li Congke” invents a personal name absent from the Chinese. Restoring Congke (as the literal already has) matches the source surface while keeping title, office, and rebellion intact.
